text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... That was rough~.
Still...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
All good, all good! Today I was properly
in full control of my running!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: In that case, what's next is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, Trainer-chan, hurry!
Let's go talk to them directly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being pulled along by Transcend,
and there—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Mr. Millionaire! Um, how are you?
No, to get on their good side...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I guess using the local language would be better.
*tap* *tap* *tap*

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Marhaban!
Ismi Transcend!

text_block_list.name: Dubai Billionaire
text_block_list.text: Transcend...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend boldly makes her pitch
to the Dubai billionaire. How will it turn out...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's too bad.
Still, I bet people at least remembered your name...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I guess direct negotiations weren't enough to score an instant invite.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Nice"? Even though I failed?
choice_data_list: That took a lot of courage to negotiate.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh... That makes sense.
Well, there's no harm in promoting yourself a bit.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Everything with the race turned out fine, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her performance in this race was certainly consistent.
With this, we can advance to the next hurdle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Targeting an easy race with weak competition is fine, but
if you want to feel an unexpected thrill, it has to be—"
choice_data_list: Next time, let's compete against formidable rivals.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Oh... a strong rival...! It's finally here, the exact thing I've been waiting for!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I had a feeling you'd give me permission soon.
Alright, let's get down to investigation time!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
A strong rival... Let's see which race
might have strong rivals showing up...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, check this out.
How about the "Miyako Stakes" in November?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's a GIII just like today, but
it's a mixed race for Classics and Seniors. On top of that...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Word on the street is
a pretty tough contemporary is showing up there.
choice_data_list: Um... what do you mean by peers?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You'll have to open it to find out.
It's still a ways off, so nothing is set in stone yet anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Taking into account the inside info from Transcend,
as well as the plans moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are several major dirt GⅠ races in December.
A GⅢ in November is the perfect stepping stone.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go with the Miyako Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Much obliged~.
Well then, I'll leave the next race in your hands~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If we have rivals, things might be tough next time.
I need to finish that gadget by then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next goal was decided.
However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Who among her contemporaries might enter the Miyako Stakes?
I should keep a close eye on the movements around us.
